image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on mossy ground. The amphibian has glossy black skin with distinct yellow spots and stripes. The head is visible on the left side, showing the eye and parotoid gland area, while the body extends towards the right. The tail is partially visible but curves out of frame or is obscured by the angle.
